collection.title: Audi A6 Saloon 2011 to 2018 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit an Audi A6 Saloon 2011-2018 which requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 21" for the passengers side. This model uses the Slim Push Button Arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
